dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, look at the front page of this newspaper. Can you read the first headline?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈlʊk ət ðə ˈfrʌnt ˈpeɪdʒ əv ˈðɪs ˈnuːzpeɪpər. kən juː ˈriːd ðə ˈfɜːrst ˈhɛdlaɪn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: ˈtaɪ ˈbædmɪntən ˈtiːm ˈwɪnz ɪn dʒəˈpæn.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good. Is the game happening now?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd. ɪz ðə ˈɡeɪm ˈhæpənɪŋ ˈnaʊ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, I think it happened yesterday. But the headline uses the present simple.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, aɪ ˈθɪŋk ɪt ˈhæpənd ˈjɛstərdeɪ. bʌt ðə ˈhɛdlaɪn ˈjuːzɪz ðə ˈprɛzənt ˈsɪmpəl.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's right. Headlines often use the present simple to talk about the past. Now read this one.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈraɪt. ˈhɛdlaɪnz ˈɔːfən ˈjuːz ðə ˈprɛzənt ˈsɪmpəl tə ˈtɔːk əˈbaʊt ðə ˈpæst. ˈnaʊ ˈriːd ˈðɪs ˈwʌn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʌvərnmənt tə ˈbæn ˌsɪŋɡəl ˈjuːs ˈplæstɪk.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt dʌz tə ˈbæn ˈmiːn ˈhɪr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It means the government is going to ban it in the future.
dialogue.reading: ɪt ˈmiːnz ðə ˈɡʌvərnmənt ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈbæn ɪt ɪn ðə ˈfjuːtʃər.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Right. And what's the breaking news on the website?
dialogue.reading: ˈraɪt. ənd ˈwʌts ðə ˈbreɪkɪŋ ˈnuːz ɑːn ðə ˈwɛbsaɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: "Heavy Rain Closes Schools in Chiang Mai."
dialogue.reading: ˈhɛvi ˈreɪn ˈkloʊzɪz ˈskuːlz ɪn ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Very good. Which issues do you usually read about? Politics?
dialogue.reading: ˈvɛri ˈɡʊd. ˈwɪtʃ ˈɪʃuːz duː juː ˈjuːʒuəli ˈriːd əˈbaʊt? ˈpɑːlətɪks?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not politics! I always read about the environment first.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈpɑːlətɪks! aɪ ˈɔːlweɪz ˈriːd əˈbaʊt ði ɪnˈvaɪrənmənt ˈfɜːrst.
